prompt: Our token-bucket rate limiter is misbehaving. A request that costs exactly the tokens currently in the bucket gets rejected even though the bucket can cover it, and a client that waits the full time to earn a steady rate still gets throttled. The limiter lives in src/limiter.mjs (it checks whether a request fits) and the token accrual lives in src/refill.mjs (it credits tokens earned over time). Fix the rate limiter so an exact-fit request is admitted, a burst past the bucket is still throttled, and a sustained earned rate is admitted. The regression command is `npm test`; it should fail before the fix and pass after the fix.
